rules: No generic Inter/Roboto. Arabic-first typography-forward layouts.
Strict RTL text alignment. Dense, readable lists.
Use mono fonts for numerical data, counts, and targets to ensure tabular alignment.

visual_enhancers.shadows: NONE. Flat UI. Use 1px solid borders for separation.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat colors. Ivory app background, White for structural content blocks.

layouts.general: Context-first, typographic-forward RTL layouts. No card carpets.
layouts.grid: High density for operational tools. Use The Technical Grid (border-collapse style layout, exposing the skeleton).
layouts.spacing: Dense but optical. p-4 to p-6 for table cells. p-8 for section padding.
layouts.navigation: Solid background header (no transparency). RTL orientation (logo on right, user actions on left).

component_patterns.reconciliation_console: Edge-to-edge tables. Use bold mono-spaced numbers for Counts vs. Targets. Use Orange background or left-border for REVIEW_REQUIRED queue items.
component_patterns.workspaces: Submissions lists as clean table rows. No carousels. Draft editor uses minimal distraction-free layout (Ivory background, strong typographic hierarchy).
component_patterns.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Solid Turquoise for primary actions, Outline Navy for secondary.
component_patterns.charts: Minimal, data-driven only. No unnecessary styling. Use Recharts with turquoise and navy data lines.

motion.allowed: Instant state changes or rapid (150ms linear) opacity/transform transitions tied directly to user selection or scroll progress.

accessibility.focus_rings: Mandatory. 2px solid Turquoise with 2px offset (ring-2 ring-turquoise ring-offset-2).
accessibility.color_independence: Never rely solely on color. Use icons or text labels alongside Orange/Green states.
accessibility.aria: Strict ARIA labels for all icon buttons and tabular data.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for any enabled transitions.

media.images: NO STOCK PHOTOS. System is data-driven. Rely on typography and layout. If logos are needed, use exact SVGs.
media.dummy_data: FORBIDDEN. Use realistic Arabic structural placeholder text mimicking actual operational data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply tailwind classes considering RTL (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, pe-4 instead of pr-4).
Never use generic placeholder text; use realistic Arabic terms like 'مراجعة مطلوبة' (Review Required).
Build components natively mapping strictly to the styling rules (flat, bordered, no shadows, no glassmorphism).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='evaluator-review-queue').
DO NOT apply universal transitions (no 'transition: all').
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect the natural right-to-left reading flow.
DO NOT use card carpets; use solid horizontal/vertical divider lines to segment content.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
No transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
Focus purely on building functional, operational, heavily tabular and typographic views.
